messages:
maria: quick RFC follow-up from the WeightIOAdapter spike — tried streaming-miniindex + tiny adapter so warmup can start before full shard fetch.

maria: high-level: small-tensor latency drops a lot, but we saw a surge of tiny fetches that hurt throughput.

dave: how are keys surfaced to the coordinator?

maria: transport calls coordinator.on_key_discovered(key, provenance, hint). provenance=(shard, off, len, checksum). hint in {NOW, BATCH}.

jing: what are hint thresholds?

maria: proposal: NOW when tensor size < 16KB (fetch immediately), BATCH otherwise (aggregate until ~1MB).

alex: backpressure model?

maria: coordinator exposes pause_discovery() when io_queue > 64; transports should pause streaming indexes.

dave: atomicity concerns for keys spanning shards or compressed tails?

maria: avoid 2PC. Prefer single-shard immediate hydration; cross-shard keys become BATCH and fall back to streaming reads at runtime. If checksum fails mark key stale and re-resolve from registry.

jing: metric plan for canary: small_fetch_rate, avg_fetch_size, fetch_p50/p95, mismatch_retries (wrong provenance), io_queue_util, OOM_rate. Sweep NOW/BATCH cutoffs.

alex: +1 on mismatch_retries metric — will catch transport/registry bugs.

maria: action items: land adapter scaffold behind a feature flag (maria), add on_key_discovered shim to transports (dave), run canary matrix small/med/large & quantized vs fp32 (jing), dashboards (alex).

qa-bot: created MLINF-2001 'miniindex adapter canary + metrics' and assigned to maria,dave,jing,alex :white_check_mark:

maria: will open PR with numbers and a short README covering checksum fallback semantics and config snippet. closing thread for now :slightly_smiling_face:
